plain.what: Generates platform-specific social posts via Gemini AI and schedules them to Notion and Buffer.
plain.when: A new marketing topic and tone is entered into the studio.
plain.result: LinkedIn, X, and Instagram campaigns are written, reviewed, and scheduled in 10 seconds.
plain.saves: Over 4 hours of copy writing and social scheduling per week

toolNotes.n8n: Best choice: transforms single prompt into array of posts and iterates over publishing APIs without usage caps.
toolNotes.make: Great Notion integration; Buffer modules occasionally have token refresh friction.
toolNotes.zapier: Requires multi-step loops that consume high monthly operation limits.
